title: Leaving My Phone Behind
sentences: I used to check my phone the moment I woke up.
Before I had even got out of bed, I had read twenty messages.
A friend suggested that I leave it in the kitchen at night.
The first few evenings felt strange, almost uncomfortable.
I kept reaching for something that was not there.
After a week I noticed that I was falling asleep more easily.
I also started reading again, which I had not done for years.
I have not become one of those people who refuse to use a phone.
I still use it constantly during the day for work.
But the hour before bed now belongs to me instead of to the screen.
